data.one_liner: A zero-dependency wrapper for Flutter golden tests with theme, locale, and multi-device support.
data.what_it_does: Streamlines writing golden tests in Flutter by reducing boilerplate and adding first-class support for themes, locales, text scales, and multiple devices in a single call. It automatically generates visual diffs and supports software keyboard simulation.
use_when: You want to write comprehensive golden tests across multiple locales, themes, and devices with minimal boilerplate.
You need to test UI layouts with software keyboards or different accessibility text scales.
avoid_when: You prefer low-level, unopinionated Flutter golden testing APIs without wrappers.
strengths: Built-in support for multi-device, dark mode, and localized test matrices.
Includes software keyboard simulation and accessibility text scale options.
weaknesses: Opinionated structure that may not fit custom testing architectures.
Turning on certain features like keyboard simulation can invalidate existing golden images.
data.setup_notes: Add the package as a dev dependency and optionally configure global test settings or a flutter_test_config.dart file.
